exemplars.title: TaleBrush: Visual Sketching of Story Generation with Pretrained Language Models
exemplars.why: TaleBrush makes surprise a persistent, ordered generation property that writers specify spatially by drawing a level trajectory, providing an unusually clear and expressive realization of the pattern.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: Chosen over the personalization slider because its drawable trajectory demonstrates that the pattern can control a property across an artifact, not merely set one global scalar.

exemplars.title: Steering AI-driven Personalization of Scientific Text for General Audiences
exemplars.why: The system presents a named 0–100 personalization slider and explicitly generates scientific-text translations at the selected degree, almost exactly reproducing the structural signature.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: Chosen over ImaginationVellum because the evidence establishes the complete control-to-generation binding, including the ordered range, widget, output property, and generation at the chosen value.

exemplars.title: ImaginationVellum: Generative-AI Ideation Canvas with Spatial Prompts, Generative Strokes, and Ideation History
exemplars.why: ImaginationVellum turns persistent canvas geometry—relative distance and 2D layout—into an ordered control surface for token weights, temperature, CFG, and related generation parameters.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: Chosen over GELEX because it supplies the signature’s important spatial-distance variant and generalizes one interaction scheme across several generation properties, whereas GELEX offers a more conventional single slider.

notes: I departed from the consensus by promoting rid 15614 from fourth to second and excluding third-ranked rid 5199. CoBRA’s quote proves that users specify a bias value on a 0–4 scale, but it does not show that the value is surfaced as a persistent control widget or that changing it re-runs generation; it therefore demonstrates the subject matter more clearly than the full structure. ImaginationVellum remains selected for design-space coverage, but its evidence is compressed and does not explicitly describe the interaction-and-rerender sequence. TaleBrush’s figure evidence similarly does not state regeneration verbatim, while rid 15614 has the strongest end-to-end evidence. No selected score was adjusted by more than 0.3 from its consensus mean.
